verdict.line: You lose if you let Jax dodge your all-in with E (Counter Strike) right as he hits 6; you win if you play the 3-5 window hard and finish your Rylai's-Riftmaker-Liandry's core before he does.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane — 48.5% over 518 games, matching Mordekaiser's 49.1% baseline top-side win rate — because both champions have a distinct power spike the other can't contest: you own levels 3-5 with Q (Obliterate) burst and W (Indestructible) sustain before Jax has counterplay, and he owns 6-8 once Grandmaster's Might's active and full E (Counter Strike) charges let him punish your melee autos. Whoever forces fights inside their own window wins lane; whoever fights on cooldown loses it.

theirWindow.when: Jax hits level 6 with E up
theirWindow.what: Grandmaster's Might active gives him bonus AD and a stun on his next hit, and if E is also available he can dodge your Q/autos for the parry stun. Do not initiate here — bait the E out with a minion or your W shield tick first, or just disengage and reset the wave.

yourWindow.when: his E (Counter Strike) just went down
yourWindow.what: Walk up and force the trade immediately — Q (Obliterate) for the single-target bonus, hold autos to proc your passive ring, and pop W before he can stack Relentless Assault attack speed back on you.

start.why: 47.4% win rate over 454 games and the 69.1% pick — the extra mana sustains your W (Indestructible) uptime through early poke exchanges, and the potions cover Jax's empowered-auto trades without a back.

boots.why: 76.4% pick and 47.6% win rate over 475 games — flat reduction on Jax's autos and his Grandmaster's Might empowered strike matters more here than magic resist, since he has no real AP source.

core.why: the slow from Q/E lets you stick to Jax through his Leap Strike resets and stops him from just walking away after his all-in window closes
omnivamp turns your 6-8 losses into non-lethal trades and is what flips the 14-18 window back to you in extended R (Realm of Death) duels
the 63.6% win rate over 55 games on this exact path comes from the burn punishing Jax's melee proximity, which he can't avoid without giving up his own trade

situational.when: jax is building crit or heavy on-hit and out-trading your autos late
you need more raw sustain to survive his level 6-8 all-in window
you are losing early trades and need armor plus grievous wounds before your core completes

runes.keystoneWhy: the 45.6% win rate, 51.7% pick page — Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage rewards exactly the extended-auto, extended-W trades that define your 3-5 window and your late R duels, where Jax can't disengage

summoners.why: 76.6% pick and the highest win rate of the three options at 49.1% — since the lane is even, Ignite is what converts your 3-5 window into an actual kill instead of just a shove, denying Jax's healing-item sustain into his level 6 spike.

playing.title: Front-load trades before 3rd auto
playing.detail: Jax's Relentless Assault ramps attack speed on consecutive hits, so extended auto exchanges favor him. Trade in Q-W-auto bursts, not standing autos.

playing.title: Pre-shield, don't react-shield
playing.detail: W (Indestructible)'s shield scales off damage you deal during its window, so activate it right before your Q lands, not after he starts hitting you.

playing.title: Never all-in into a live E
playing.detail: If Jax's Counter Strike is up he can dodge your entire burst and stun you back. Wait it out or bait it with a minion-adjacent auto first.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 spike specifically
playing.detail: Grandmaster's Might's active is a straight bonus-AD stun on top of whatever E does. Do not contest a fight the instant he hits 6 — let the wave reset instead.

playing.title: Save your own R for a dead E
playing.detail: Realm of Death is a pure stat check; pull him in only when his E charges are down and your core items (Rylai's/Riftmaker) are online, since that's where your sustain and slow flip the duel.

playing.title: Deny his Leap Strike resets
playing.detail: Jax's Q can gap-close off minions. If you're ahead, thin the wave near you so he can't use it to re-engage after disengaging from your window.

playing.title: Pivot to armor if behind
playing.detail: If early trades go his way, rush Plated Steelcaps into a Bramble Vest item — flat armor mitigates both his auto-resets and his empowered ultimate strike.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.18.1) for this exact Mordekaiser-vs-Jax top matchup; the timing breakdowns, trade patterns, and window calls are my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Jax will slowly regain control over lane as he reaches level 6. Purchase Plated Steelcaps, Bramble Vest, and other items that increase armor before closing in to deal damage.
